description: This source file contains unit tests for the VoicePushToTalkHotkey component, testing its behavior when modifier keys are pressed and released, using an internal Counter actor to verify the number of begin/end events.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: An actor used internally in tests to count the number of times hotkey began and ended events are triggered.

methods.name: incBegin
methods.description: Increments the 'began' count, indicating the begin action was triggered.

methods.name: incEnd
methods.description: Increments the 'ended' count, indicating the end action was triggered.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current counts of began and ended actions as a tuple.
